route_assumptions: Ohio shifts assume Tokyo->Taiwan 25ms, Tokyo->Ohio 125ms, Ohio->Taiwan 175ms. Not measured. Taiwan Binance capture connected directly, so treating it as Tokyo->Taiwan is a proxy.
binding_assumption: Direct CompressedOracle word ID 0x54 is treated as SPCX immediately, independent of future acceptance logs. This is a scoped heuristic, checked retrospectively for false positives.
calldata_clock: Earliest recorded local relay receipt, mapped to recorder monotonic time
execution_delay_definition: Trigger receipt to hypothetical fill, including assumed compute/sign/send/sequencing delay; no separate 5ms exchange delay is added
initial_inventory_assumption: Same token balance across routes: 500 / 139.91 (Taiwan initial Binance ask), floored to 18 decimals. All routes use common initial bid mark 139.90 USDG; actual acquisition cost is unknown.
